effect:
Blocks additional attack effects.

Covert Cloak protects your Pokémon moves affects, aka like flinching from Air Slash... frozen by Ice Beam... or the stat drops from Shadow Ball!

This is useful on Pokémon that hate random secondary effects ruining their momentum. It won't stop the damage, just the extra effects. If you're tired of getting flinched to death by Serene Grace users or randomly frozen at the worst times, Covert Cloak solves those problems.
